headline: The UV-tracking Gem made me rethink how sunlight affects my health, not just my appearance
summary: Review of a UV-tracking wearable necklace. Highlights how sun exposure impacts health beyond appearance. Author experienced heat exhaustion despite seeking shade.

headline: Costco members can get $5 off the reimagined Ocarina of Time
summary: Costco members can save $5 on the digital Ocarina of Time remake. The discount brings the game's price down to $54.99. This saving almost offsets the annual Costco membership fee.

headline: Discogs’ Kevin Lewandowski can’t live without his AeroPress
summary: Discogs founder Kevin Lewandowski reveals his essential gadget. He champions the AeroPress as his indispensable coffee maker. Discogs is the go-to platform for vinyl collectors worldwide.

headline: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
summary: NYT Cooking's AI assistant proved useful for quick dinner ideas. It successfully helped create a satisfying weeknight chicken dish. However, the AI nearly disastrously impacted a cake recipe.

headline: LEGO Black Friday 2026 Sales: What to Expect
summary: Anticipate significant discounts on LEGO sets for Black Friday 2026. An expert predicts the types of deals shoppers can expect. Prepare for major savings across various LEGO themes.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Frankenstein 4K UHD Blu-ray, Dragon Ball Super Complete Series, Gears of War: E-Day, and More
summary: Daily roundup of top deals for November 7, 2026. Featured offers include Frankenstein 4K UHD Blu-ray. Discounts available on Dragon Ball Super Complete Series and Gears of War: E-Day.

headline: Missing Teen Saved From Alleged Kidnapper After Seeking Help in Among Us
summary: A Utah teenager was rescued from an alleged kidnapper. She used the game Among Us to contact another child for help. The rescue occurred at a man's home in Oregon.

headline: Sony Announces Indefinite Delay for PlayStation's Pulse Elevate Wireless Speakers Days Before Launch
summary: Sony has indefinitely delayed PlayStation's Pulse Elevate speakers. The announcement came just days before the global launch. No new release date has been provided for the wireless audio device.

headline: Briton among six killed in 'far-right' shooting in Krakow
summary: A British national is among six victims in a Krakow shooting. Police state a far-right attacker fired randomly in Main Market Square. The assailant drove into the square before opening fire.

headline: Germans wrestle with what to do with Hitler's destroyed Eagle's Nest retreat
summary: Germany debates the future of Hitler's demolished Eagle's Nest retreat. Options range from rebuilding the site to abandoning it entirely. The discussion focuses on how to address its Nazi past.

headline: Veterans shouldn't sleep rough this Christmas, Burnham says
summary: Andy Burnham calls for an end to veterans' homelessness this Christmas. Downing Street confirms PM will write to councils on Armistice Day. Councils are urged to draw up plans to house veterans.

headline: Royal Family join veterans and families at Festival of Remembrance
summary: Senior members of the Royal Family attended the annual Festival of Remembrance. The solemn event took place at London's Royal Albert Hall. It was held on the eve of Remembrance Sunday.
